title: Magic-item operations, state machines, economies, grants and containment: faithful or absent
description: Follow-up split from eshyra-o9bd.19.4.5 (PR #653) per user decision 2026-10-11 (bd memory magic-item-faithful-or-absent). Source: fresh full subsystem review eshyra-o9bd.19.4.5.7 (read its notes in full). Scope: every member of that review whose path is NOT mechanics.effects / variants[].mechanics.effects - i.e. operations and activation (S2, S3), stateMachine transitions/timers/terminations (S4), entityGrant lifecycle/control/revertOn (S5), economies/charges/daily gates and cross-operation composition (S6), containment (S1.16-S1.18), spellStore, rollManipulation. Rule: each typed claim states the printed predicate exactly or is removed from the typed structure and replaced by an executionReadiness clause with readiness 'adjudicated-by-design' carrying a verbatim source span; never invent defaults (activation cost 'action' where the text names none -> no typed cost, adjudicated); fix outright contradictions (Dagger of Venom coat prerequisite; elemental vessels/Elemental Gem revertOn concentration-ended vs conjure elemental; Rod of Alertness activate-aura vs activate-protective-aura; Luck Blade wish once per dawn; Nine Lives Stealer charge only when slain). Anything use_item can execute (green readiness) must be exactly faithful and keep working; check every runtime consumer (toolUseItem, itemState, itemExecutionReadiness, usage counters, reset executor) before removing a field. Absorbs eshyra-b0m4 (Glamoured bonus action). Evidence: the generalized source-agreement checks extended to these blocks plus verbatim-span validation for adjudicated clauses; representative eligible/ineligible scenarios per root-cause group from the review.
